parameters.query:
SELECT 
        a.id AS idabono,
        CONCAT('00', ad.idfranquicia, ad.iddocumentacion) AS ticket,
        a.idcliente,
        a.metodopago,
        a.fecha,
        a.fechapago,
        ad.fechadocumentacion,
        a.nombrecliente,
        d.rfcorigen AS RUT,
        d.nombreusuario AS capturo,
        UPPER(d.nombreclientedestino) AS nombreclientedestino,
        UPPER(d.coloniadestino) AS comuna,
        (
            SELECT SUM(cantidad) 
            FROM pkt1franquicia1.documentaciondetalle 
            WHERE iddoc = ad.iddocumentacion
        ) AS bultos,
        a.foliotemp,
        a.seriefactura,
        a.foliofactura,
        a.estatus,
        a.correo,
        ad.monto AS importeDoc,
        a.importe
    FROM maestro.abonos a
    JOIN maestro.abonosdetalle ad ON a.id = ad.idabono
    JOIN maestro.documentacion_all d ON (d.id = ad.iddocumentacion and d.idfranquicia=ad.idfranquicia)
    WHERE a.id IN (
        SELECT id FROM maestro.abonos WHERE estatus = 'P'
    )
    AND a.fecha BETWEEN '2021-04-16' AND '{{ $json.fecha_fin_sql }}'
    ORDER BY idabono DESC;
